name: The characters' elbows bend backwards
body: Dean (2026-11-17): the characters' arms look backwards in the game after the animated body landed. Every forearm rotation in the mannequin's poses is a negative angle about x, but a positive x angle swings a hanging limb forwards, so each elbow folds the forearm behind the upper arm. Knees correctly use negative angles; elbows must use positive.
plan: Flip the sign of every forearm x angle in Mannequin.nox (idle, stride cycle, jump, fall, crouch, reach). Add a test that no pose folds a forearm behind its upper arm, then check player, companion and partner in a capture.
acceptance_criteria: Elbows bend forwards in idle, walk, run, jump, fall, crouch, wave and reach
A test fails if a forearm folds backwards
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
Screenshots posted to the project chat
